text: {"lessons":["Selling winners solely because they are above my average cost can shrink positions without improving my overall portfolio outcome; assess each trade in portfolio context.","With prices moving randomly, neither recent gains nor losses provide a reliable forecast, so avoid trading on price history alone.","Do not let reluctance to admit a mistake or the urge to check and trade frequently drive decisions; choose to buy, sell, or hold based on what best serves the portfolio now."]}
